verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rev AI has async jobs with webhook notifications on completion. Nothing in the pack documents a job parameter for attaching user-supplied identifiers or metadata, or echoing such values back in job results or webhook payloads. The axis applies to an async transcription API, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach my own identifiers or metadata to a job and get them back in results and webhook payloads
